about.title: About Dijkstra
about.subtitle: An independent, local-first developer platform engineered to teach computer science and software architecture from first principles.

mission.title: Built for Depth, Not Shortcuts
mission.p1: Modern web development often prioritizes fragmented snippets and framework churn over foundational understanding. Dijkstra is built to reverse that trend.
mission.p2: We believe deep technical intuition comes from structured paths, hands-on practice, and zero distraction. That is why our platform is completely local-first, lightweight, and engineered with dual-language parity from day one.

firstPrinciples.title: First Principles
firstPrinciples.desc: Understanding why systems work under the hood rather than just copying high-level syntax.

localFirst.title: Local & Frictionless
localFirst.desc: No mandatory account walls or bloated trackers. Your machine, your storage, your progress.

bilingual.title: Bilingual Parity
bilingual.desc: Equally rigorous technical content authored natively in both Arabic and English.
